# Shop API v1

All requests go to https://api.shop.example/v1 and need the header X-Api-Key.

## Orders

GET /orders
Lists your orders, newest first. Query parameters: status (open, shipped, cancelled), limit (default 20, max 100).
Response: {"data": [{"id": "SO-155", "status": "open", "total": 49.90}], "next": null}

GET /orders/{id}
One order with its lines.

POST /orders
Places a new order.

DELETE /orders/{id}
Cancels an order that has not shipped.

## Products

GET /products
The catalogue. Response: {"data": [{"sku": "A-1", "name": "Mug", "price": 9.90}]}

PATCH /products/{sku}
Changes a product.

## Webhooks

POST /webhooks registers a webhook URL.
